What EFM is.
The problems EFM solves.
High electricity bills
Inefficient cooling driving operating cost up year after year.
Rising carbon emissions
Compliance risk against regulation and sustainability targets.
Ageing infrastructure
Chiller plants past their best, and a capital bill to replace them.
Operational disruption
Downtime and inefficiency from poor maintenance and old systems.
Why owners choose it.
Zero upfront investment

IAQ funds the implementation. Your capital stays free for core business priorities.

Up to 30% lower cost

IAQ publishes savings of up to 30% on electricity consumption where the measures are applied in full.

Performance assurance

Service Level Agreements cover system reliability, energy efficiency and uptime.

30 years in HVAC

IAQ has 30 years of experience in HVAC.

EPCC capability

IAQ engineers, procures, constructs and commissions the works. On district cooling it carries on into operation and maintenance.

Regulatory compliance

Upgrades help facilities meet energy efficiency regulations and Building Energy Index (BEI) requirements.

District cooling record

IAQ was main contractor for Malaysia’s largest district cooling plant. Its references also include Malaysia’s first multi-varsity district cooling system.

Seven energy management services, end to end.

Designed to reduce operating expenditure, increase efficiency and improve sustainability outcomes.

01
Energy Audit
Comprehensive energy audits to identify inefficiencies, optimise system performance and implement targeted Energy Saving Measures (ESMs).
02
Energy Efficiency Solutions
HVAC and building system optimisation through targeted retrofits and AI-based automation.
03
Energy Performance Contracting
IAQ fully funds and delivers system upgrades, from HVAC retrofits to smart controls, and shares in the operating cost savings achieved.
04
Cooling-as-a-Service / Build-Operate-Transfer
A utility-based cooling model: chilled water supplied under a long-term service agreement. Pay only for the cooling you consume.
05
District Cooling System
End-to-end solutions from feasibility studies through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, operation and maintenance.
06
Maintenance & Reliability
Comprehensive and non-comprehensive maintenance packages with skilled manpower for daily operations and emergency response.
07
Cogeneration System
Efficient on-site power and thermal energy generation that reduces energy costs, improves reliability and supports sustainable facility operations.

How district cooling works.

Chilled water is made at one central plant and piped to every building on the network. Each building cools on it, with no chiller plant of its own.
